svg.text: N_RANKS full lanes (ingress -> L2) fan into ONE L3 cap. Cells own NO FSM - state lives in one FSM_TABLE[{rank,bank}] (written @ FSM-commit, read by L0/L1/L2); the scoreboard is SPLIT by arb level (bank / BG / rank+global timing regs, each with its own UPDATE). One shared back-end drives DFI.
